# Gramlot examples 0.3.5 — Gallery tabs created on click

- Require the core API introduced in 0.3.3, with no upper version bound or lockfile.
- Start both galleries with navigation and Introduction only; create the selected contentPane, iframe, explanation and code in Source on first click.
- Reuse opened tabs and iframe Data. Repeated pending clicks share one creation; older replies cannot override the latest selection. A failed creation can be retried.
- Read JavaScript lesson files only when requested and attach the guided demo only when its lesson is opened.
- Keep both server adapters and the serverless gallery on the same gallery implementation. The unpublished c23 website lesson is not included.

Controlled candidate measurements reduced median index startup by 47–60% across Python/JavaScript cold/repeat visits. First selection does more work on demand; already opened lessons are retained. These are small samples, not guarantees. Unit tests and Chromium/WebKit cover Source insertion, retained edits, code, inspector and mobile views. Offline guided playback retains its pre-existing file-origin limitation.
